description:
A shareable, named OpenSearch custom analyzer. Decides how text is broken into searchable tokens — see the OpenSearch text analysis overview for the high-level concept. The owned pipeline (char filters → tokenizer → token filters) lives in settings; see TextAnalyzerSettings for the field shape.

Example shape:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "scientific",
  "settings": {
    "tokenizer": { "name": "standard" },
    "tokenFilters": [
      { "name": "english_stop", "definition": "{\"type\":\"stop\",\"stopwords\":\"_english_\"}" }
    ],
    "indexFilterOrder":  ["lowercase", "english_stop"],
    "searchFilterOrder": ["lowercase", "english_stop"]
  }
}

Reference this analyzer from a SearchConfiguration's defaultIndexAnalyzer / defaultSearchAnalyzer, or from a ColumnAnalyzerOverride, using its qualified name {organizationName}-{name}.

id.description: The unique ID of this text analyzer.

organizationName.description: The Organization that owns this resource. Immutable after creation.

name.description: Resource name (letters, digits, underscores, must start with a letter). Combined with organizationName to form the qualified name '{organizationName}-{name}'. Immutable after creation.

settings.description: The analyzer pipeline — char filters, tokenizer, token filters, and the order they are applied at index vs search time. See TextAnalyzerSettings.

etag.description: Synapse Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) value. Send the etag from a GET back on update; a mismatch returns 409.

createdBy.description: ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: When this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: ID of the user that last modified this resource.
